play.intro: Four challenges, one at a time. Pick a name to start. <y>The clock for task 1 starts the moment you press START.</y>
play.typeCode: At the station PC, type your code:
play.howTo: Read your task here, then answer at the station. Solve it to unlock the next one.
play.act1Info: Decode this image — the clue is somewhere in real life. Answer at the station — spaces and dots don't matter.
play.act1NoImages: No images yet — ask a staff member.
play.act2Info: Guess a number from {min} to {max} at the station. After each guess you hear <y>HIGHER</y> or <y>LOWER</y>.
play.act2Strategy: You have {n} guesses. Luck won't save you — plan a strategy that always finds the number in {n}.
play.act3Info: At the station, pick the exact official colour of this brand from 4 very similar shades:
play.act3NewBrand: A wrong pick gives you a new brand.
play.act4Info: Find this senior around campus and ask them, then answer at the station. A wrong answer gives you a new senior.

admin.title: ADMIN.EXE
admin.act1Help: Shown in this order. Answers are letters A–Z only (case-insensitive).
admin.brandsHelp: Each attempt uses 3 random enabled brands ({n} enabled; need at least 3). Verify hex codes against the official brand guidelines.
admin.majorsHelp: Players pick one when they register. In task 4 every major is an answer choice, in this order (the station uses keys 1–9, so keep it to 9 or fewer).
admin.seniorsHelp: Task 4 asks “What major is [senior] from?” about a random senior from the major the player picked (any senior if that major has none). A wrong answer gives a new senior.
admin.seniorsEmpty: No seniors yet — task 4 can't be solved until you add one.
admin.adsHelp: MP4/WebM, max ~95 MB each. A random one plays after every wrong answer. With none uploaded, a 10-second “stand by” screen is shown.
admin.resetPrompt: This deletes ALL players and results. Type RESET to confirm.
admin.i18nHelp: Edit any text in the app. Changes are saved when you leave a box and show on the next page load. Clear a box to go back to the default from messages/<lang>.json. Keep {placeholders} and <tags> as they are.
admin.i18nHint: Type to search, or press SHOW ALL.
